capabilities: Search all notes with substring matching and query operators (phrases, exclusions, OR)
Filter results by folder, tag, property, date range and open todos
Rank results by relevance and show excerpts with highlighted hits
Index and search canvas and base files alongside Markdown notes
Keep or dismiss individual results within a search run
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; stores its index in IndexedDB outside the vault. README includes measured performance benchmarks and states the plugin registers no default hotkey.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches only whole words or prefixes and cannot find terms inside words, fold umlauts like kueche/Küche, or search canvases and bases.
summary: Full-vault search overlay with substring (infix) matching, operators, path/tag/property/date filters, typo tolerance and ranked excerpts.
